repair.scope:
Repair Z marginals on a genuine common-threshold R completion.

The old histograms, their masses, K, and every R marginal are fixed to the
latest 3889-row exact point.  Z marginals may change.  Each old histogram
is split into exact deterministic R modes by the common threshold.  Conditional
Z marginals are then affine; independent conditional bits give a genuine common
distribution.  All old rows and all sixty Z->Z index classes are imposed.
This is an extension test on this one chosen R completion, never a full-domain
half certificate or an SPE construction.

atoms.scope:
Materialize a small joint (R,Z) support preserving all affine moments.

This is a finite common membership distribution for the necessary graph, not
an SPE strategy or a sufficiency assertion.

literal.scope:
Data-only reconstruction of every added Z->Z row.

No research row generator is imported.  All 66 reply labels and all ordered
label pairs are expanded literally.  The report concerns a jointly distributed
membership witness in the enlarged necessary-condition domain, not an SPE.

independent.scope: Independent differential extension audit; original 702+5 hist/K-only rows inherited unchanged from identified source. No SPE claim.
independent.conditional_joint_realization: R deterministic; Z Bernoulli independently per orbit conditional on mode; all rows affine in Z so first moments suffice.
